sources.evidence: The S3 CreateSession API requires the s3express:CreateSession IAM action for the directory bucket.
The S3 Express CreateSession action supplies the resource types and condition keys; reuse the pinned SAR action rather than inventing an s3 action.

The API operation table lists appstream:CreateFleet and the additional actions recorded here. Tagging and role passing are request dependent; the conditional policy review classifies these exact links and keeps PassRole diagnostic-only with a manual concrete-role and iam:PassedToService requirement.
Request parameters establish when tags or a role are supplied; they do not establish unconditional grants.
